article.title: Acusativo: masculino inanimado
article.chapter: Acusativo y animacidad — Винительный падеж и одушевлённость

claims.summary: The accusative singular of inanimate masculine consonant-declension nouns matches nominative.
The source gives Он передал стакан as an accusative direct object whose form equals nominative.
Он передал стакан is an attested example in Cornell’s accusative paradigm.
The rule source explicitly limits its stated paradigm to inanimate zero- and o-declension nouns, excluding animate and a-declension forms.
